main_text.head: Breuis de morte & confessione Iohannis Huss narratio.
main_text.p: Iohannes Huss Bohemus in Concilio Constantiensi publicè pronunciatus est hæreticus, & singulari ritu spoliatus iure sacerdotali, per episcopos damnatus ad supplicium ignis, & traditus seculari potestati. Cùm educitur ad locum supplicij, gestat in capite mitram episcopali similem, in qua depicti erant duo dæmones, cum inscriptione: Hæresiarcha. Subinde inter eundum has voces ingeminauit: Iesu Christe fili Dei uiui, qui passus es pro nobis, miserere mei. Tandem impositus rogo, eandem precationem aliquoties alta uoce repetens, fortiter supplicium pertulit. Hæc anno 45. recitauit.
main_text.head: Eberhardi ducis Vuirtenbergensis, decedentis ex hac uita, pia confessio & consolatio.
main_text.p: Eberhardi ducis Vuirtenbergensis pij & præstantis principis confessio: qui cum iacuisset totum triduum, & iam morituro præberetur corpus Domini, erigens se quasi conualuisset, dixit: Ago tibi æterne Deus pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi gratias ingentes, quòd ostendisti consolationem conscientiæ

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The final word "conscientiæ" is printed at the right margin of the last line. Some words in the first lines are partly blurred by the binding curve; "suo" and similar readings were checked against context. Line-end words are kept as printed.
